name: Rotation Chain Hoist
desc:
Engineered for heavy industrial applications, the Ableforge CB360 is an innovative manual chain hoist featuring a patented 360° rotating hand chain guide. This revolutionary design allows users to operate the hoist from virtually any angle, ensuring the operator remains safely out of the danger zone beneath the load.

Built for maximum durability and safety, the hoist is equipped with a premium low-maintenance braking system, sealed roller bearings, and a hardened load chain that delivers exceptional strength and longevity. Its fully enclosed housing protects internal components, making it ideal for rugged outdoor environments. A specialized black variant is also available, specifically designed to blend seamlessly into entertainment industry rigging setups.
